key_reasoning.reason: Five small, independent touch points: DatasourceConcurrencyManager (slot acquire/release logging, datasource_name kwarg), code_datasource_processor (passes name to the manager), azure_devops_wiki_loader (bounded REST calls), llm_factory and dependecies (embedding request timeouts), plus the new config setting. No new abstractions, but several subsystems are involved.

12 files per diffstat (437 insertions, 7 deletions) maps to XL by the file-count rule. 6 of the 12 are test files, and the source edits are small and additive, so the score reflects count rather than depth.
